WHERE THE
WORK HAPPENS.

A place to sharpen your basketball skills and build the strength behind your game. Step inside P2V.

ON THE COURT

Room to work
on your game.

The basketball area brings multiple hoops and space for drills into one training environment. From ball handling to shooting, it’s a place to put coaching into practice.

  • Multiple baskets for shooting and finishing work
  • Court space for ball handling and footwork drills
  • Cones and training equipment for focused practice
Explore basketball training

BEYOND THE COURT

Build the athlete.
Support the game.

Alongside the basketball space, P2V has a dedicated area for strength and conditioning. Weights, ropes, and marked turf support the physical work that complements skill development.

  • Weight rack, bench, and plates for strength work
  • Marked turf for movement and conditioning drills
  • Battle ropes and a variety of training equipment
See our training approach
